name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with local Product Packs, Shared UI Rules, hardened Design System, and five-product evaluation coverage.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production interfaces through a layered local architecture: Product routing and Product Packs, scope-relevant Shared Product UI Rules, and a hardened modular Design System. Version 3 adds recorded real-world evaluation coverage across Dashboard, Website, Web Application, Mobile Application, and WordPress Plugin scenarios, with explicit evidence and validation limitations. The Design System includes DTCG 2025.10-compatible token interchange guidance, component-state contracts, Light/Dark/High Contrast behavior, Persian/RTL typography, responsive/product variants, safe runtime configuration boundaries, and migration governance. Persian-facing language validation is delegated to persian-writing.
capabilities: Route UI work by product type before design
Load scope-relevant Shared UI Rules after Product Packs
Build and audit typed semantic token architectures and component-state contracts
Design Light Dark High Contrast RTL and responsive product variants
Design dashboards with local executive analytical operational monitoring CRM and admin modes
Design websites web applications mobile applications and WordPress plugin UI
Validate runtime design governance and migration boundaries
Validate redesigns with rendered and visual-regression evidence
Route Persian-facing UI to required language QA
defaultPrompt: Classify the product, load its Product Pack and relevant Shared UI Rules, then improve it without breaking behavior.
Design this website or web application using the correct product-specific UI/UX rules and validate representative states.
Improve this mobile or WordPress plugin UI using its required Product Pack while preserving constraints.
